poses.label: Stand
poses.description: Stand with soft knees and both dumbbells just in front of your thighs.

poses.label: Hinge
poses.description: Push your hips back and let the dumbbells travel close to your legs.

poses.label: Stretch
poses.description: Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch and can still keep your back steady.

poses.label: Stand up
poses.description: Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.

checks: Soft knees, hips moving back, weights near the legs and a controlled hinge depth.
Compared pose captions with the exact built-in exercise cue.
Checked camera bounds, equipment anchoring, and contact throughout the interpolated loop.
limitations: The simplified figure and fixed camera show the main movement path. In-app phone playback and admin review are pending.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js.
